text_block_list.text: The Nippon Derby is finally just around the corner!
Today, a press conference was held with the Umamusume scheduled to run in the race.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Aah-hah-hah-hah-ha!
My enthusiasm for the Derby!? It's already settled!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A clean win! An overwhelming win! A total victory!!
Nothing less is acceptable!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Who shall bear the title of "World's Strongest"?!In the ring known as the Derby,
I'll show you aaall, yeeesss!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now, now, if you get all fired up before the race even starts, you'll just wear yourself out~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm just gonna take things easy
and go at my usual relaxed pace~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Guess you'll just have to look forward to the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
E-Enthusiasm, my enthusiasm...!
Uhm, uhm, uhm...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"To my, my moms, um...
Number one in Japan... well, uh..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ......I'll do my best!!

El Condor Pasa, Seiun Sky,
Special Week...

Naturally, powerhouse Umamusume whose names had echoed
even before their debuts are registered for this Nippon Derby.

In the venue brimming with heat and anticipation
ahead of the grand stage, Grass Wonder was—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I am Grass Wonder.
It is a pleasure to meet you~

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Ooh, here she comes—the "Monster II"...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse meee!
Can I ask a question?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, here you go~.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Following your success in the Junior Class, expectations for you are sky-high, but are you feeling any pressure!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed~. It would be a lie to say
I feel no pressure whatsoever, though."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"‘A hundred blessings gather naturally of their own accord.’
First, I will face this calmly and with a peaceful mind."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: They say the Nippon Derby is a race where "the luckiest Umamusume wins," after all~.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I see, calm and collected as always!
Well then, next—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, sorry to keep you waiting~.
The press conference wrapped up without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I still have plenty of stamina to spare~.
Well then, let us begin training at once...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Graaaaasssss!!
Wait, wait, waaaait!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The Monster Bird, El Condor Pasa, is in the house!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... El. What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean 'what's this'!
I have simply come to declare war once again, desu!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spirits are running as sky-high as ever, I see~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“Wait, didn't you just finish addressing those things
at the press conference a moment ago?”

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No way!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Because you don't speak your true feelings
in places like that, Grass!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fighting spirit is something to be kept hidden,
"a proper Yamato Nadeshiko must always remain serene"—or so they say!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And that is why I have come back once more, YEEEES!
—Grass!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I've been looking forward to this, so, so much!
A direct clash! Head-to-head! An all-out battle!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The strongest in the world! The absolute peak!!
It's time to settle this, yeeeeees!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My, oh my~.

Grass Wonder remained silent for a moment,
but then, keeping a quiet smile, she declared with conviction.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...I shall be your opponent.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Getting caught by El put us a bit behind schedule~
Let's make up for lost time, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: They were directing some serious fighting spirit at you.
They were directing some serious fighting spirit at you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
After all, every single Classic race
is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El, Sei-chan, and Spe-chan. Every single one of them will put everything they have on the line.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: However, I will not let you pass ahead.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Because waiting at the end of this road is an even...
even bigger and taller wall.
—The 'Japanese Derby' draws near.
